name: official outcome/label pipeline

label_contract.authoritative_outcome: Official resolved Polymarket outcome parsed from preserved Gamma market snapshots
label_contract.eligibility: Only resolved evidence observed at or after market end may become a label
label_contract.canonical_source: Earliest eligible resolved snapshot ordered by downloaded_at then snapshot id
label_contract.conflict_policy: Contradictory resolved snapshots or semantic relabel attempts fail closed
label_contract.rerun_policy: Identical natural-key reruns are no-ops/existing rows
label_contract.start_reference_policy: NULL unless independently verified from first-party resolution data
label_contract.end_reference_policy: NULL unless independently verified from first-party resolution data

downstream_constraints: Phase 3 raw-data exclusions remain binding for raw-dependent feature datasets.
Phase 4 source-availability metadata, including unavailable historical L2 and audited Bybit HTTP 403 gaps, must remain explicit downstream.
Phase 6 features may use only data available at the feature timestamp and must carry explicit missing-data flags.
